drift_vs_published.heuristic: faces whose mtime is newer than the published face's own mtime

limits.count_is_not_an_address: the published face names no member, so its own 587 cannot be reconstructed by name -- only measured
limits.crlf_folded: the byte stream is normalised, so a pure CRLF difference is not content under this rule
limits.mtime_heuristic: a face rewritten later is indistinguishable from one added later by mtime alone; the list is offered with that caveat
limits.reader_domain_unstored: the reader corpus is stamped but not stored here; its own store is E362's mechanism (source side)

reader_domain.rule: sha256 over LF-normalised text, one line per `path<TAB>digest`, order-free

rules.member: path<TAB>sha256 over the member's bytes with CRLF folded to LF
rules.pin_id: sha256 over the sorted member lines
rules.supply: a member is replayable from git only if HEAD holds it AND the work copy equals that blob; everything else must be in the store
rules.why_bytes: a population that walks an arbitrary directory is not a UTF-8 population: 1 of the members here do not decode as UTF-8, and a text-level digest would depend on the decoder
